title: Personal Portfolio Website
subtitle: Full-stack Engineering Portfolio
summary: Full-stack portfolio platform showcasing projects and engineering experience.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: This portfolio is a full-stack, data-driven website designed to communicate software engineering experience and representative project work to recruiters, engineering managers, and technical interviewers.
The information architecture separates concise homepage previews from full About, Journey, and Projects pages so content remains quick to scan and straightforward to maintain.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
items: Design and implement the Vue 3 and Vite frontend architecture and responsive page layouts.
Build FastAPI endpoints backed by validated JSON content.
Create reusable UI components, including the shared ProjectCover implementation.
Integrate API loading, error, and empty states into detail pages.
Maintain static image paths and WebP-oriented asset conventions.
Containerize and deploy the frontend and backend through the existing automated workflow.

architecture.title: Architecture
paragraphs: The application separates a Vue single-page frontend from a lightweight FastAPI content service. Structured JSON files are validated with Pydantic before their data is returned to the frontend.
highlights: Vue Router provides Home, About, Journey, and Project routes.
Homepage previews use small local datasets to avoid backend cold-start delays.
Detail pages consume versioned FastAPI responses through a shared API client.
Docker images package the services for deployment to Google Cloud Run.

items.title: Fast first-page content
items.description: The homepage uses focused local preview data while full detail remains backend-driven, balancing startup performance with maintainable structured content.

items.title: Consistent responsive design
items.description: Shared layout, spacing, typography, and cover specifications must remain consistent across two-column home and full-width detail layouts.

items.title: Scalable content updates
items.description: Data schemas and reusable components reduce the amount of template code required when projects or journey entries change.

deployment.title: Deployment and Operations
paragraphs: The frontend and backend are containerized separately and deployed to Google Cloud Run through the repository's GitHub Actions workflow.
highlights: Nginx serves the built frontend and applies the existing SPA fallback behavior.
Uvicorn serves the FastAPI application inside the backend container.
Environment-specific API configuration keeps local development and deployed requests aligned.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons Learned
items: A clear boundary between preview and detail data improves both perceived performance and information density.
Shared components and validated schemas make visual and content changes safer.
Documentation must be updated alongside architecture changes to remain useful for future redesign work.
